QUOTE: "**Compile time.** Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` together... When both are present, `platform.c` drops the runtime setter entirely, so calling it fails to link."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair and says they are mutually exclusive. When the macros are defined, the runtime setter is dropped and calling it fails to link.
